nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every Monday at 08:00. Downstream Code+If nodes restrict actual execution to the first Monday of the month only.

nodes.name: Compute Report Month
nodes.notes: Reports always cover the PRIOR fully-completed calendar month, since the job runs at the start of the following month.

nodes.name: Fetch Monthly PDF Report
nodes.notes: Reuses the existing Supabase Service Role Header Auth credential — matches the app's SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, which /api/expenses/reports/monthly accepts as a Bearer token for service-to-service calls.

nodes.name: Email Miss May
nodes.notes: Needs manual credential wiring: select the Gmail OAuth2 credential in n8n UI before activating.
